description: Defines an enum MetricDataType for various data types used in Sparkplug metrics, including type checking, conversion from integer, and associated class types.

classes.name: MetricDataType
classes.description: Enumeration of metric data types with methods for type checking, conversion, and retrieving class types.

methods.name: checkType
methods.description: Checks if a given object matches the MetricDataType; throws AdaptorException if not.

methods.name: toIntValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the MetricDataType.

methods.name: fromInteger
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding MetricDataType enum value.

methods.name: getClazz
methods.description: Returns the Class<?> associated with the MetricDataType.
